candidates.name: Coordinate tools and resources
verified_facts: OS provides OSTN15 and OSGM15 developer packs, raw grids and test resources.
OS states that transformation accuracy better than 3 metres should use OSTN15 and OSGM15 instead of the simple transformation in its spreadsheet.
semantic_limits: Historical source lineage that records OSTN02/OSGM02 is preserved as provenance; it is not silently relabelled as OSTN15/OSGM15.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LiDAR Composite spatial metadata index GeoPackage guidance
verified_facts: LiDAR Composite and SurfZone DEM download zip files now contain a spatial metadata index in GeoPackage format.
The spatial metadata index describes the spatial location and temporal extent of raster elevation data.
Technical guides describe the format and attribute schema of the index files.
semantic_limits: A metadata container-format change does not itself change raster elevations; exact survey/tile lineage and SHA-bound raster evidence remain required for numeric reproducibility.
